function: JS_PUBLIC_API bool BuildStackString(JSContext* cx, JSPrincipals* principals,
anchor: nextFrame = js::GetFirstSubsumedFrame(cx, principals, parent, SavedFrameSelfHosted::Exclude, skippedNextAsync);
why: The hook needs the walk's own locals (frame, nextFrame, skippedAsync, skippedNextAsync) and a `continue` of Mozilla's loop: no guard or notice at the head of the function can see them, and a wrap-expression on GetFirstSubsumedFrame/UnwrapSavedFrame would be two rewritten lines with a rooting wrapper and would change the `!nextFrame` last-frame test of the V8 format, so not the same result.
